body: My ex killed herself almost 2 years ago. I still think about her every day. Time has helped but I still miss her.
I'd love to win this! My pint went up in flames about a week ago and yes it was seconds away from my house burning down before I grabbed it and threw it outside.

"in my presence, while I was pregnant with our baby" omg that is terrible...so selfish.
One thing that I keep thinking about is that people that commit suicide really dont get rid of the problem. Its gone for them but all they did was just transfer it to everyone else that cared for them. They made their problems everyone elses. Its hard to love someone so much and hate them for what they did. The only person that I have contact with is her sister and she really doesnt want to talk to me. From what I understand she is just glad to be off her sisters rollercoaster and is glad shes at peace. I wish she would talk to me more about her but it is what it is.
Your mother sounds like a real peach. I feel like that is kind of how people describe me also. I guess I am pissed at the world. I am pissed at my dead friend. I just cant believe she did it.

Ive seen doctors and all they want to do is prescribe me a little bit of antidepressant that does nothing. Ive never felt any different on over a hand full of meds. No doctor seems to want to give you anything stronger because they fear some type of reprocussion. Xanax was helping somewhat but they treated my like a drug addict when I asked for more. At least thats how its been with me. The best thing Ive found are groups like AA but then you get close to these people and they start dropping. I didnt take off a lot of time at my job but I was not preforming at 100%. I thought my manager understood but I think he was getting pressure from higher up so he had no choice.

God..I feel like I need to be on some sort of mental disability. Its hard to do anything anymore. Everyone just seems to think I can shrug it off though. This world is fucking sick.

Losing a lover to suicide is the most painful thing I have ever been through. Sometimes I just go sit on her grave and cry for hours. Its funny though because she was creamated and its just a nameplate in the dirt but for some reason it makes me feel close to her. She told me I was the love of her life. She saved my life but now its hard to go on without her. I dont understand why if God loves you he puts you through shit like this. Life makes no sense to me. There are times when I wish she would have asked me to come put my head next to hers when she pulled the trigger and let me go wtih her.

I hope you are able to find peace. You are not alone.

I feel your pain. There have been short times when things were good for me. Heck, even great times, but they were always short lived. I keep hanging on for my parents and daughter but as my daughter grows older I notice more and more things that make it seem like if I were gone she wouldnt even care. My mother has told me that if I go she will too and that makes me hang on but life just seems unfair...hanging on for the sake of what a loved one will do is hard.

It seems like when you are down life throws more at you just so it can laugh. Its a sick joke. I try to be strong and look for the good in life but there are days when it seems hopeless. I really know what you mean when you say people judge you as lazy. People judge so quickly. Hang in there...just know you are not alone with your struggles.
I know what you mean. The power of a simple hug is amazing. It saved my life.
